# ![Jonathan Lindbloom](assets/images/jonathan-lindbloom-pseudospectrum-inline-osu.png){.home-name-image width="4740" height="1027"} {.home-name}

:::: {.home-intro}
::: {.home-copy}
I am a visiting assistant professor of mathematics at [The Ohio State University](https://math.osu.edu/), where I am mentored by [Dongbin Xiu](https://sites.google.com/view/dongbin-xiu/home). I received my Ph.D. in mathematics from Dartmouth College in 2026, where I was advised by [Anne Gelb](https://math.dartmouth.edu/~annegelb/) and completed my dissertation on [*Advances in Computational Methods for Sparsity-Promoting Linear Inverse Problems*](https://digitalcommons.dartmouth.edu/dissertations/520/). My research interests include (Bayesian) inverse problems, numerical linear algebra, and scientific computing, including scientific machine learning.
